proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_regime + by_signal_family (directional-long) = Bull regime = 100%; UP_TRI+BULL_PROXY directional-long = 100% (100.0%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_family (directional-long) = Bull regime = 100%; UP_TRI+BULL_PROXY directional-long = 100%; recommended action: Pause new UP_TRI/BULL_PROXY entries in CapGoods until that cell drops below 15% via natural Day-6 exit; require any new adds to be non-Bull-regime hedges or defensive sectors (Pharma/FMCG already present — do not add). If Bull regime deteriorates on regime_watch, hedge index short (NIFTY/BANKNIFTY put spread) sized to 15-20% of book notional.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If Bull regime flips to Choppy or Bear (regime is still young post-flip), the entire 17-position book moves against direction simultaneously with no offsetting exposure. Bull×UP_TRI cohort has no validated edge (Candidate tier, n=145) to justify the concentration, so drawdown would be unbounded by prior WR/edge data — a full-book directional-long shock event.

evidence: Top cell UP_TRI×Bull×CapGoods at 17.65% (3/17), approaching the 0.20 cell threshold
Three additional cells clustered at 11.76% each (Pharma, Chem, Bank) — no diversification offset
Matched Bull×UP_TRI cohort at Candidate tier only (n=145) — unvalidated edge
21st+ consecutive warn day; regime has been Bull only ~10 sessions post-Choppy flip
risks: Recommendation may be over-cautious; concentration may be edge-validated
Trader may already be aware; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.recommended_action: Pause new UP_TRI/BULL_PROXY entries in CapGoods until that cell drops below 15% via natural Day-6 exit; require any new adds to be non-Bull-regime hedges or defensive sectors (Pharma/FMCG already present — do not add). decision_metadata.tail_risk_scenario: If Bull regime flips to Choppy or Bear (regime is still young post-flip), the entire 17-position book moves against direction simultaneously with no offsetting exposure. Bull×UP_TRI cohort has no validated edge (Candidate tier, n=145) to justify the concentration, so drawdown would be unbounded by prior WR/edge data — a full-book directional-long shock event.
decision_metadata.llm_rationale: Regime concentration is triggered at 100% Bull (17/17, well above the 0.80 threshold) and the UP_TRI×Bull×CapGoods cell breaches the 0.20 cell threshold at 17.65% (3/17) — just below the hard line, but combined with three other cells at 11.76% (Pharma, Chem, Bank) the book is a tightly clustered directional-long monoculture. UP_TRI is 12/17 = 70.6% and combined with BULL_PROXY the book is 100% directional-long. Matched Bull×UP_TRI cohort sits only at Candidate tier (n=145) — unvalidated edge across all concentrated cells, extending a multi-week warn streak.
